name: dotagents
description: Generic .NET engineering standards, and how to communicate about code, distributed as versioned, load-on-demand skills routing to a browsable standards tree. The TypeScript/React half is its own marketplace, tomjseery/react-agents.

plugins.name: dotnet-standards
plugins.description: The generic C# and .NET standard: style and naming, comments and XML doc, dependency injection, logging, validation, EF Core persistence and multitenancy, seeding, the Result/Option carriers with their typed errors and transport terminals, module and service-boundary structure, gRPC contracts, keyed strategies, and the unit/integration/E2E test tiers. Names no product.

plugins.name: communication-standards
plugins.description: How to write about code so a reader can verify it rather than trust it: explaining how something works, and drafting a review comment or message someone else posts under their own name. Language-agnostic.
